notes.title: Release of the full version
notes.content:
Friends, we are finally coming out of early access!

Despite the fact that this is now a full-fledged release, which we are certainly happy about, we also want to say that we failed to achieve all our goals.

You get a game with:
- single player mode with a bot (for training or playing alone)
- 1-on-1 network mode with another player (for example, with your friend)
- local mode on the same computer (just like with your friend or family member)
- localization into 4 languages - Russian, English, Norwegian and Danish.

We were not able to make a full-fledged matchmaking and ranking games as we were going to, and this was preceded by several reasons:
- we initially made a mistake with the choice of a platform for creating multiplayer, and as a result, its capabilities did not allow us to implement the idea.
- not all of our developers were able to continue development, especially those who were engaged in the online mode of the game.
- we lacked experience, as we are just students who decided to make their first game.

Nevertheless, we are very glad that we managed to implement the main features, the main gameplay and present them to you.

Due to the fact that not everything was implemented according to the idea, we are reducing the purchase price of the game.

Thank you for supporting us, it was very valuable!

notes.title: The release of Daldos will take place on August 25!
notes.content:
[h2]Upcoming release![/h2]

We are very happy to announce that the game will be released next Wednesday - August 25!

This is a very big event for us! And we hope that this event is just as important and interesting for you. We will be glad to meet each of you in our game!

But before you buy Daldos, you should know that it is currently being released in Early Access. What is the reason?

It's very simple - despite the fact that the game is 90% ready, the opinion of the community on its account is very important to us, and we would also like to involve everyone interested in the development of Daldos. This means that we are aiming for the best quality of our game that you could get.

That is why we are launching Daldos in Early Access - to track down all the controversial and unpleasant moments, correct them and add to the game what you would like to see in it.

We are sensitive to the comments of the community and none of them will be ignored. So if you have something to say, please say it. It doesn't matter what it will be - a comment, negative or positive feedback, a suggestion or something else-be sure to leave all this in the comments on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603600/Daldos/]game page [/url], [url=https://steamcommunity. com/app/1603600/discussions/0/4939872515513606400/]in a special discussion [/url] or in the community at [url=https: / / gamejolt. com/games/daldos/595296]Game Jolt [/url].
Remember that it is your comment that can become part of Daldos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/8038824ec15e818c4992ac932717d6fd1c160bfa.jpg[/img]

[h2]We don't just sit and wait[/h2]

At the same time, we are not going to just sit and wait for comments from you or for someone else to do our work. We continue to work on improving all the elements of the game.

But more important for you, dear players, is the bonus for purchasing Daldos in early access - you will receive the first set of customization as a gift immediately when it is released at the end of September. Also, we have prepared exclusive game elements that will allow you to stand out among those players who decided not to participate in Early Access, but to wait for the full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/a66327dd100a3f76a83214e2e124da5e2d113cf9.jpg[/img]

[h2]"And what will I get now?"[/h2]

Of course, you have the question " What will I get now?". This is an excellent and important question, which we undoubtedly have something to answer.

By purchasing the game at the moment, you get a fully working game that has 3 of the 4 game modes:
- Playing with a bot (there may be some problems in the actions of the AI)
- Play on the same device with another player
- Play online with another player

Ranked games are not available yet, but they will appear in Daldos in the near future, when we will definitely be sure of the correct and honest operation of this system.

Thus, now you get a 90% ready-made game and have the opportunity to understand it, understand its structure, train your skills, think over victory tactics and get ready to defeat other players in ranked games with "one left"!

See you on board the ship, glorious warriors!

notes.title: Temporary free demo
notes.content:
[h2]Release of demo[/h2]

We released a demo Daldos demo that you can feel the gameplay of the oldest game of Scandinavians on your computer, evaluate the work done and make a decision about whether you are interested in this game.

The following things are available in demo:
- game for two players on one device;
- Game for two multiplayer players;
- all current models of warriors;
- Unlimited game until 22.06.2021.

06/22/2021 is the last day when the demo version is available.
Have time to play Daldos up to this point!
[IMG] {steam_clan_image} /40311623/8038824c15e818c4992ac932717d6fd1c160bfa.jpg [/ img]

[h2] How to play [/h2]

1. Go to the application page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603600/daldos/
2. Load the free demo game and launch it on your PC.
3. Open learning through the "Tutorial" button
4a. Start the game on one device through the "One Device" button
4b. Start the game through a multiplayer through the "Network game" button
5 B. Create a room for playing or join the already existing room.
6. Have fun!

[h2] Your opinion [/h2]

Please do not forget to leave your feedback to the game!
Now the game is at the stage of active development and therefore feedback from our players is very important for us.

Feel free to express your thoughts and suggestions, we are ready to listen and take all the information received into processing.

Send your feedback through Google shape - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1pwn-w3ep0quey5bd0binb05t9y3yaoii_qd0o8zqqri/edit

notes.title: Multiplayer and new models
notes.content:
[h2]New models[/h2]

Two new models of warriors have been added to the game, which will diversify your gameplay, namely-archer Seidman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/2526567032000a9c8d2c4d733581f2a4ed87761b.png[/img]

These are ranged fighters who have silent kill skills or magical abilities.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

But most importantly - in Daldos there is a multiplayer, which is the main mode of the game.
We have already conducted internal testing within the team and calibrated it for full operation.

In the near future, some of you will be able to get access to testing the game yourself.

This is very cool and inspires us!
Stay in touch and stay tuned. And don't forget to add the game to your playlists!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/8038824ec15e818c4992ac932717d6fd1c160bfa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New characters
notes.content:
Our artists have finished the concepts of new characters for the harsh Vikings.

[h3]The first one is [b]archer [/b]. [/h3]

An excellent hunter, an excellent tracker, a high-class shooter - he will help you achieve victory with high accuracy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/934213e86a5236f1e44ffb15ad94bec06c15ee1f.png[/img]

[h3]Another newcomer is [b]seidman[/b]. [/h3]

Who are the Seidmans? These are the Scandinavian shamans.
Magical powers are coming to the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/96c1b9b49f50214eeacf7ed393ea21d3a4bf0d11.jpg[/img]

Both new warriors will be added in the release version of the game.

[h3]Another new feature[/h3]

Soon, we will show you another interesting new product that can completely transform the visual of the game individually for you.


[h3]P.S.[/h3]

We do not want to mislead you, so we will immediately say that for the classic competitive game mode, this innovation will affect the dynamics of the battle, its beauty and diversity. At the same time, the game balance will not be affected, i.e. these units will not have abilities that give them an advantage over others.

However, since we plan to support the game after the release, you will be able to enjoy such things in a separate game mode.

[h3]What do you think about it?[/h3]
